Author: tea-time-xiv
Name: Autools
Description: Quality of life automation features including auto Priority Aetheryte Pass usage (/passauto) and auto-cancel Jog buff after Sprint expires (/nojog).

Author: tea-time-xiv
Name: Cratools
Punchline: Highlights the items and gear you no longer need.
Description: Paste Teamcraft's inventory-cleanup list and Cratools fades the inventory slots you need to keep, so the removable items stand out. The armory cleanup scan marks gear no class you play can wear, or that you already own something better than, and tints it in the Armoury Chest. Read-only: it never moves or discards anything.

Author: tea-time-xiv
Name: Safety Lock
Punchline: Soft Safety Lock to prevent accidental in-game interactions
Description: Blocks vendor windows, duty finder interactions, and quest acceptance dialogs when enabled. Use /safetylock to toggle. Features enable-on-startup and individual feature toggles.

Author: Tea Time
Name: Tea Time Deck
Punchline: Drive FFXIV from a Stream Deck.
Description: Exposes a local API that a companion Elgato Stream Deck plugin talks to. Provides auto-populated browsers for every emote, mount and minion you own, plus live status readouts on deck keys. Open /ttd for a link to download that companion plugin.
Changelog:
Two halves, both attached below. You need both.

Author: Tenrys
Name: ZoomTilt
Punchline: Change 3rd person camera angle depending on camera zoom.
Description:
Change the 3rd person camera angle character config setting depending how zoomed in you are.
Zoom out, and you will be able to see more of the world. Zoom in, the camera will be focused on your character.
